create_dataset_cifar10: create CIFAR-10 train and test datasets with random crop, horizontal flip, and normalization transforms
train_model_xla: train a ResNet-18 model on CIFAR-10 using PyTorch XLA with SGD optimizer and NLLLoss
test_model_accuracy: test a trained model on CIFAR-10 and return classification accuracy as a float
run_multiprocess_training: run distributed CIFAR-10 training across multiple TPU or GPU workers via XLA multiprocessing spawn
configure_platform_flags: configure training platform as cpu, gpu, or tpu with epochs, batch size, learning rate, and momentum flags
